stock.description: Hengdeli Holdings Limited, alongside its associated companies, primarily operates in the retail and wholesale markets for watches and fine jewelry. The group also undertakes the design, production, and fitting out of commercial spaces. Additionally, its business includes the manufacturing and distribution of watch components and packaging materials. Established in 1957, the company's corporate headquarters are located in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
